fields.description: What this image is, in the profile's own vocabulary (e.g. 'hero' for a generated shot, 'translated' for a reworked supplier photo).
fields.label: Kind

fields.description: The variant this image belongs to. Empty for a listing-level image. On approval a variant image is written to that variant's `variant_image`, not to the listing's images table. Shares the parent's Image Status — there is no per-variant lifecycle.
fields.label: Variant

fields.description: The input photo this image was derived from, when there was one.
fields.label: Source URL

fields.description: The resulting image. Empty when it could not be produced — see Note.
fields.label: URL

fields.description: The instruction used to produce this image, for profiles that generate imagery.
fields.label: Brief
